body: I've messed up with git again, sorry.

> ```c++
> WorkerThreadPool::get_singleton()->get_caller_task_id() == WorkerThreadPool::INVALID_TASK_ID
> ```

``return singleton->threads[th_index].current_task->self;``[worker_thread_pool.cp#L720](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e5498020b6250d9284efcdcf0f85f39d48d8548f/core/object/worker_thread_pool.cp#L720)
